div.head: CHn cor 6
div.ab: Omnia placita et omnia debita quae fratri meo debebantur condono exceptis rectis firmis meis et exceptis illis quae pacta erant pro aliorum hereditatibus vel pro eis rebus quae iustius aliis contingebant.

I remit all pleas and all debts which were owing to my brother, with the exception of my legal rents and the payments which had been agreed upon with regard to the inheritances of others or with regard to property which more justly belonged to others.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 278–279 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text (K–M) not yet added
